findings.one_line: The reproduction only controls bounded x (and then |x|=o(sqrt(m))); the asserted tail step omits the x=Theta(sqrt(m)) regime, where the treatment singular value can cross a baseline singular value, so (9)--(20) do not establish the joint Ky-Fan/profile cancellation or the global O_p(1) argmin localization in (21)--(23).

The load-bearing o_p((n1 t1)^(-1/2)) fitted treated-post mean is not reproduced: (9) invokes unconstrained rowwise least-squares normal equations to prove the radius constraints inactive, although those normal equations are valid only after inactivity; the Frobenius bound (7) alone permits exceptional rows and does not yield (9), (10), or (17).

Its final finite-array ATT conclusion uses mu_{a,N} mu_{b,T}->mu_a mu_b, i.e. ass:a-moments and ass:b-moments, but neither is in depends_on; the conclusion cannot be reproduced from the declared dependencies alone.

The cited source record attests the below-threshold edge-vector assertion only for rank one and under its derivative condition, whereas this node states it for every strictly subcritical fixed-rank perturbation without those qualifications; narrow the node or supply a source covering the stated generality.

cited_checks.note: The attested Gaussian rectangular specialization has variance 1/T, aspect c in (0,1], deterministic fixed-rank perturbation, threshold c^(1/4), and the stated squared edge/outlier limits after squaring equation (9).

The attested Section 3.1 formulas algebraically equal the two stated supercritical overlaps and Theorem 2.9 supports distinct-spike orthogonality, but the supplied record limits Theorem 2.10's below-threshold edge-vector claim to r=1 with a derivative condition; it does not verify this node's all-subcritical fixed-rank clause.
